title: ALMA Measurements of Circumstellar Material in the GQ Lup System
question: What are the properties of the circumprimary disk of GQ Lup A (size, geometry, stellar mass) and is there a circumplanetary disk around the companion GQ Lup b?

evidence.quote: we use the dust temperature-stellar luminosity relationship of (cite: and13): $T_\text{dust}=25(L/L_\odot)^{1/4}$.
we adopt the frequency-dependent dust opacity $\kappa_\nu = 10(\nu/10^{12}\text{ Hz})$ cm$^{2}$ g$^{-1}$ from (cite: beck90)

recipe.goal: Image continuum and measure flux/size, companion limit
recipe.method: CLEAN imaging; 2D Gaussian fit to the image; 3 sigma upper limit at GQ Lup b position assuming point source

recipe.goal: Derive dust masses and CPD limits
recipe.method: Optically thin mass M=F D^2/(kappa B(T)); optically thick size limit
assumptions: kappa=3.4 cm2/g at 870 um; T_dust=24 K (disk A), 18 K (at GQ Lup b); gas-to-dust 100 for total CPD mass

recipe.method: Parametric disk model (self-similar surface density, power-law temperature, Keplerian) with RADMC-3D images, Fourier transformed and sampled at data uv points, chi2 likelihood
key_parameters: Free parameters: M*, i, PA, r_c, T10, q, Mgas, xi, vsys, RA/Dec offsets
assumptions: Constant CO abundance ~1e-4 (ISM-like); vertically isothermal, hydrostatic equilibrium; Keplerian rotation

recipe.method: Combine 13CO gas mass with dust mass

answer_key.quantity: Continuum flux density of GQ Lup A disk

evidence.quote: we obtain a total flux density for the circumprimary disk of $77.8\pm0.2$ mJy
The circumprimary dust disk is compact with a FWHM of $59\pm12$ AU
we determine a $3\sigma$ upper limit on the flux density of any circumplanetary disk surrounding the secondary of $<0.15$ mJy
the resulting $3\sigma$ upper limit on the dust mass is $M_\text{dust}<0.04$ $M_\oplus$

answer_key.quantity: Stellar mass GQ Lup A (13CO fit)

evidence.quote: The models imply a stellar mass, $M_*$, for GQ Lup A of $1.03\pm0.15$ $M_\odot$.
the best-fit inclination is $i = 60.5\ensuremath{^\circ}\pm0.5\ensuremath{^\circ}$ and position angle is $PA=346\ensuremath{^\circ} \pm1\ensuremath{^\circ}$
gas-to-dust ratio for the circumstellar disk around GQ Lup A to be $4.7\pm0.5$
The systemic velocity in the LSRK frame is $3.00\pm0.01$ km s$^{-1}$

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels and clean thresholds/masks for continuum and CO imaging
Channel width and velocity resolution of CO cubes
MCMC sampler, priors, and model grid/inner and outer radii settings for DiskJockey
Which spectral windows/channels were used in visibility fits
missing_for_reproduction: Sampler/priors and model setup details for DiskJockey
score_reason: Public data, scripts and open-source modeling code, but imaging and fit settings are partly missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numerical results (flux, mass, inclination) and a mostly complete recipe with open code.
